mission: Turn the certified WNBA warehouse into a leakage-safe historical learning and calibration system.

modules.name: Certified Historical Feature Store
modules.purpose: Create leakage-safe training features from primary certified ALT observations and prior completed player-games only.

modules.name: Probability Learner
modules.purpose: Estimate true prop hit probabilities from historical features with walk-forward validation.

modules.name: Calibration Layer
modules.purpose: Calibrate predicted probabilities by stat, side, score band, and confidence bucket.

modules.name: Edge and EV Engine
modules.purpose: Compare calibrated probability with market implied probability and rank positive-EV opportunities.

modules.name: Walk-Forward Backtester
modules.purpose: Evaluate V5 chronologically without future-data leakage and publish ROI, Brier, calibration, and drawdown.

modules.name: Champion Challenger Gate
modules.purpose: Promote V5 only when it beats the protected V4 baseline on predeclared validation metrics.
